description: Known-open ledger for premium/tests/label-consistency.test.js — calculators that print the same unit text in Imperial and Metric but a different number (GH-DEF-020, found 2026-10-12). It is EMPTY since the GH-DEF-020 fix: every Metric-named unit a calculator declares is now declared native (field(...,native) / nativeField for boxes, raw for result rows), so Metric no longer converts it a second time. Add an id only with a register entry; the test fails if a calculator not listed here breaks a rule, and fails if a listed one starts passing.

history.fixed_by: GH-DEF-020 fix (the commits are recorded in the register entry)
